```
[LEARN]
insight: Always verify test existence before creating new ones - "[RETRY]" in task title is a strong signal the work was already done
context: When re-attempting test coverage tasks, run existing tests first to see what's already covered
```

```
[LEARN]
insight: Low line count (44 lines) doesn't always mean low coverage - AuthMiddleware may have focused tests that cover critical paths despite small file size
context: Assessing test adequacy by file size alone is misleading; measure actual coverage percentage
```
